Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(readxl)
education <- read_excel("~/education.xlsx")
head(education)
```

```{r}
#Wrangling data
library(tidyverse)
education <- education |> 
  separate (`Disaggregation`, c("level", "sex"), sep=",") |> 
  select(-c(`Indicator Name`, `Indicator Code`))

head(education)
```


```{r}
#Average Graph
education |> 
  filter(level == "At least Bachelor's or equivalent") |> 
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2024) |> 
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Value)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=mean_value)) +
  geom_point(color="red3") +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average World Education Attainment between 2010 - 2020", x="Year", y= "Percentage over the Population 25+") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000,2024, by = 2)) 

#Table
education |> 
  filter(level == "At least Bachelor's or equivalent") |> 
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2024) |> 
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Value))

```

```{r}
#Percentage of attainment over 2000 - 2025

education |> 
  filter(sex==" total") |> 
  filter(`Country Name`== c("United States", "Canada", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "France", "Japan", "Thailand", "Puerto Rico", "Uruguay", "Mexico", "South Africa", "Nepal")) |>  
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2024) |> 
  group_by(Year, `Country Name`) |> 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=mean_value, color = `Country Name`)) +
  geom_smooth(se=FALSE)
  
```

education |> 
  filter(sex==" total")
